key: The official scorer at a cricket match is the leader
name: ch05_leader_follower
alt: A cricket scorer writes runs in the scorebook while a stadium scoreboard, a TV and a radio commentator copy the same score.
scene: A wide, slightly elevated three-quarter view of a sunny Indian cricket stadium during a match. In the lower-left foreground, the official scorer — a middle-aged man in a cream half-sleeve shirt and spectacles — sits at a small wooden desk under a striped canopy, pen in hand, carefully writing into a large open ledger-style scorebook; a stack of pencils, an eraser and a steel tumbler of tea sit beside it. This is the single source of truth. From the scorebook, three clean curved arrows sweep up and to the right to three copies of the same score "214/3": (1) a tall stadium scoreboard with lit digits above the stands, (2) a flat-screen TV in a living room inset bubble where a family watches from a sofa, and (3) a radio commentator in a small glass booth wearing headphones and speaking into a microphone, with sound waves going out to a transistor radio held by a man on a scooter. Crowds in the stands in the background, a sliver of green pitch with tiny players. Bright midday light, cheerful mood. Labels: "LEADER" directly under the scorer's desk; "FOLLOWERS" once, in a gentle arc above the three copies.

key: sending a document by registered post
name: ch05_sync_async
alt: Split scene: a man waits at a post office counter for an acknowledgement card, versus dropping a letter in a red post box and walking away.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided down the middle by a thin vertical line, same young office worker (late 20s, blue checked shirt, laptop bag) in both halves. LEFT panel: inside a busy Indian post office with a wooden counter, steel grille and a wall clock reading ten past four, he stands at the registered-post window, letter handed over, waiting with arms folded and a slightly impatient face while the clerk stamps a pink acknowledgement card; a short queue forms behind him and a dotted line shows the letter travelling to a distant house and the card coming back. RIGHT panel: outside on a leafy street, the same man drops a letter into a classic red cylindrical Indian post box and walks away briskly and relaxed, already talking on his phone and holding a coffee cup; a faint question-mark cloud floats above the post box to show nobody yet knows if the letter arrived. Soft afternoon light, warm and calm. Labels: "SYNC" at the top of the left panel, "ASYNC" at the top of the right panel.

key: You join a coaching class in week 6
name: ch05_new_follower
alt: A late-joining student photocopies a friend's notebook marked page 47 while the class continues live behind her.
scene: A warm, sunlit coaching-class classroom seen from the side. In the foreground left, a student who joined late — a teenage girl with a backpack still on — stands at a photocopy machine copying a thick borrowed notebook; a neat stack of warm, freshly copied pages sits on the tray with a yellow sticky note on top reading "page 47". Behind her, in the middle ground and right, the class is in full flow: a teacher in a kurta writes equations on a large green blackboard, and a row of students at wooden benches copy notes live, pens moving. A bold curved arrow runs from the photocopied stack toward the live class, showing her catching up from page 47 to the current lesson. Ceiling fan, wall calendar, tiffin boxes on the benches for detail. Bright morning light from tall windows. Labels: "SNAPSHOT" on or just above the photocopied stack; "CATCH UP" along the curved arrow.

key: You pay a shopkeeper by UPI
name: ch05_read_your_writes
alt: A worried customer sees an empty payment screen while the shopkeeper shows a green tick; an inset shows one server lagging.
scene: A small, colourful Indian kirana shop counter seen from the customer's side. On the left, a young man in a hoodie holds his phone close, eyebrows raised and worried, because his phone screen shows an empty transaction list with a small spinning loader. Across the counter on the right, the friendly shopkeeper with a moustache smiles and turns his own phone toward the customer, showing a big green tick. Behind the counter: shelves of colourful packets, glass jars of sweets, a hanging bunch of bananas and a QR-code stand on the counter (plain pattern, no brand). In the upper corner, a small inset bubble shows two server cabinets: the left one up to date and glowing, the right one lagging behind with a small hourglass icon, a dotted arrow between them. Warm evening shop lighting. Label: "PAID" once, near the green tick on the shopkeeper's phone.
